items.q: A rough skin-coloured papule on the finger with black dots and loss of skin lines is?
items.exp: Common warts are HPV papillomas with thrombosed capillary dots and interrupted dermatoglyphics.
r: Correct. Rough papule with black dots.
Incorrect. Corns keep skin lines over pressure points.
Incorrect. That has stuck-on waxy papules.
Incorrect. That is a sun-exposed scaly patch.
items.kp: Black dots with lost lines mean wart.

items.q: Multiple small flat skin-coloured papules on the face and dorsa of hands in a teenager are?
items.exp: Plane warts are flat HPV lesions of the face and hands that koebnerise along scratches.
r: Incorrect. That has umbilicated domes.
Incorrect. That has shiny penile papules.
Incorrect. That has tiny white cysts.
Correct. Flat facial papules in teens.
items.kp: Flat facial teen papules are plane warts.

items.q: Paring a painful sole lesion reveals bleeding points and interrupted skin ridges. This favours wart over corn because?
o: Corns preserve skin lines with a central translucent core
Warts always lack pain on squeezing
items.exp: Warts disrupt dermatoglyphics and bleed from capillaries; corns keep lines over a painful translucent core.
r: Incorrect. Corns pare to clear core without bleeding.
Incorrect. Warts are rough, not smooth.
Correct. Lines preserved means corn, disrupted means wart.
Incorrect. Both can hurt on pressure.
items.kp: Skin lines decide wart versus corn.

items.q: A child with atopic eczema has pearly dome papules with central dimples on the trunk. The agent is?
items.exp: Molluscum shows umbilicated pearly papules from poxvirus with Henderson-Paterson bodies.
r: Incorrect. That gives hand-foot-mouth lesions.
Correct. Umbilicated domes are molluscum.
Incorrect. That gives rough warts.
Incorrect. That gives grouped vesicles.

items.q: Recurrent grouped vesicles on the same spot of the lip with burning prodrome indicate?
items.exp: Herpes labialis recurs at the same mucocutaneous site with prodromal tingling then grouped vesicles.
r: Correct. Same-site grouped vesicles.
Incorrect. That gives honey crusts.
Incorrect. That gives oral-genital ulcers.
Incorrect. That fissures the angles.
items.kp: Same-spot grouped lip vesicles are herpes.

items.q: A dermatomal vesicular rash spares crossing the midline, with vesicles on the tip of the nose. The eye risk is flagged by?
items.exp: Nasal-tip vesicles mark nasociliary branch zoster with high risk of ocular involvement needing eye review.
r: Incorrect. That is upward eye roll on closure.
Incorrect. That is afferent pupillary defect.
Incorrect. That is myasthenic lid fatigue.
Correct. Nose-tip lesions warn of eye disease.

items.q: Itchy red papules with a central vesicle in different stages on the trunk, denser centrally, in a febrile child are?
items.exp: Chickenpox shows centripetal dew-drop vesicles in all stages at once with fever.
r: Incorrect. That burrows finger webs with nocturnal itch.
Incorrect. That clusters on exposed sites.
Correct. Centripetal polymorphic vesicles.
Incorrect. That is centrifugal with uniform stage.

items.q: A household shares intense night-time itching with burrows on finger webs and genitalia. The best next step after diagnosis is?
o: Treat the patient plus all close contacts with a scabicide with laundered bedding
items.exp: Scabies needs simultaneous treatment of contacts with permethrin-class scabicide, itch control and hot laundering.
r: Incorrect. Mites persist without therapy.
Correct. Treat patient plus contacts together.
Incorrect. Steroids alone mask infestation.
Incorrect. Antibiotics only cover superinfection.
items.kp: Night itch with burrows needs whole-household therapy.

items.q: Thick crusted hyperkeratotic plaques with fissures and nail dystrophy in an immunosuppressed elder with minimal itch suggest?
items.exp: Crusted scabies carries millions of mites in heaped crusts with low itch, highly infectious in the immunosuppressed.
r: Correct. Heaped crusts with teeming mites.
Incorrect. That is diffuse red scaling.
Incorrect. That is greasy yellow facial scale.
Incorrect. No such entity exists.
items.kp: Heaped crusts with low itch mean crusted scabies.

items.q: Nits cemented firmly to occipital hairs with excoriated nape in a schoolgirl indicate?
items.exp: Head lice glue ovoid nits to hair shafts near the scalp with occipital itch and posterior nodes.
r: Incorrect. That breaks hairs with dots.
Incorrect. That gives loose greasy scale.
Incorrect. That gives hard shaft nodules.
Correct. Cemented nits are lice.
items.kp: Cemented occipital nits mean head lice.
